title: Scientific Fault Injection Lab scenario (sicnu.lab.faults/1)
description: Declarative fault scenario: a clean base fixture, a fault transform with a seed, sandbox rules, expected observable deltas, an expected diagnosis and a learning objective. The C++ loader (src/faultlab/fault_scenario.cpp) is the authoritative implementation; this schema documents the same contract for authors. Fail-closed: unknown family ids, relations and schema versions are rejected, never defaulted.

family.description: Closed vocabulary from the fault-family registry (src/faultlab/fault_registry.cpp).

params.description: Family-specific params. The per-family closed vocabulary (required/optional names) is published by the registry; the transform rejects unknown or missing params with faultlab.fault_unsupported_params.

seed.description: Drives every stochastic step of the transform; identical seeds replay identically.

fixture_id.description: Deterministic fixture from the built-in factory (src/faultlab/fault_fixtures.cpp).

max_bytes.description: Byte budget for the fixture copy; 64 MiB ceiling.

require_source_unchanged.description: The runner re-digests the source fixture after the run; a drift fails faultlab.source_mutated.

value.description: Operand for equals/not_equals/changed(implicit 0)/delta_ge/delta_le; boolean for truth_is.

text.description: Operand for text observables (band_roles, acquisition_dates, channel_order, ...).

signature.description: Expected lab diagnostic signature (all_negative_index, all_nodata, kappa_near_zero, blank_change_mask, crs_mismatch, scale_stripes) or the typed diagnostic.unmatched when no canonical signature covers the family.

rules_ref.description: Grading rules reference (sicnu.lab.rules/1 family) for artifact-level checks.

must_fail_assertions.description: Assertion ids that must fail on the faulted artifact (existing OutputVerifier assertion kinds only; no new kinds).

required.description: May not be waived: every scenario runs in a verified temp-copy sandbox.
